name: react-sketch-project
description: Monorepo for react-sketch, a sketch element for React applications backed by fabric.js

scripts.build: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace react-sketch build && yarn workspace showcase build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @react-sketch/eraser typecheck && yarn workspace @react-sketch/laserpointer typecheck && yarn build:packages && yarn workspace react-sketch typecheck && yarn workspace showcase typecheck
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['packages/eraser/dist', 'packages/laserpointer/dist', 'packages/react-sketch/dist', 'packages/showcase/build']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace react-sketch test
scripts.test:watch: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace react-sketch test --watch
scripts.test:coverage: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace react-sketch test:coverage
